feature_loading_enabled.description: Shows the loading screen that prepares the app before the start screen.

feature_sample_enabled.description: Shows the sample feature screen, the reference pattern for new features.

ads_enabled.description: Master switch for every ad. When false, the app shows no ad at all.

ads_first_session_grace_seconds.description: Time without full-screen ads at the start of the first session after install, in seconds.

ads_inlist_every_count.description: Number of list items between two native ads inside a list.

ads_interstitial_max_per_session_count.description: Maximum number of full-screen ads shown in one session.

ads_interstitial_min_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time between two full-screen ads (interstitial and full-screen native), in seconds.

ads_native_load_timeout_seconds.description: Time to wait for a native ad before its space is removed when no ad is available, in seconds.

ads_personalized_regulated_regions_enabl.description: Allows personalized ads in regions that require consent (EEA, UK, Switzerland), for users who consented. Users who declined never get them.

ads_sample_native_small_enabled.description: Shows ads in the placement sample_native_small (native_small). Off by default.
